nonBlockingIssues.description: intelligence.py has 2 endpoints (list_briefings, get_briefing) using direct require_auth(request) calls instead of Depends(require_auth). Inconsistent with the 50+ other endpoints that use Depends pattern.
test_main_py_is_under_300_lines asserts <350 despite function name suggesting <300. main.py is 305 lines, a minor threshold mismatch.
_openai_key_works() makes synchronous HTTP call during startup. Works correctly but blocks for up to 10s if OpenAI is slow. Primary Ollama path unaffected.
768-dim nomic-embed-text vectors padded to 1536 with zeros. Wastes ~50% pgvector storage. Future optimization opportunity to change EMBEDDING_DIM to match native model dimension.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention: 'All protected API endpoints MUST use `user: dict = Depends(require_auth)` as a function parameter. Do NOT call `require_auth(request)` directly — this bypasses FastAPI's dependency injection.'
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: intelligence.py has 2 endpoints using direct require_auth(request) vs 50+ endpoints using Depends pattern. Flagged in both round 1 and round 2 reviews.
